<div class="d-flex flex-column Truncate">

</div>

<a href="#discussion-7404351" id="discussion-7404351-permalink" class="Link--secondary js-timestamp d-inline-block ml-2">Nov 1, 2024</a>

<div class="d-none d-sm-inline-flex ml-2">

</div>

</div>

<div>

<div class="edit-comment-hide">

<table class="d-block" role="presentation" data-paste-markdown-skip="">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 100%" />
</colgroup>
<tbody class="d-block">
<tr class="odd d-block">
<td class="d-block color-fg-default comment-body markdown-body js-comment-body"><h3 id="description" dir="auto">Description</h3>
<p>I've perform some experiments to ensure that all vulnerabilities are properly covered. I tried the following approaches and for some reason the results do not match.</p>
<ol>
<li>SBOM generation using <code class="notranslate">syft scan docker:...</code> -&gt; <code class="notranslate">trivy sbom ...</code></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li><code class="notranslate">syft scan docker:mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/runtime:6.0-alpine -o cyclonedx-json &gt; runtime-alpine.json</code></li>
<li><code class="notranslate">trivy sbom runtime-alpine.json</code></li>
</ul>
<ol start="2">
<li>Use <code class="notranslate">trivy image</code></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li><code class="notranslate">trivy image mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/runtime:6.0-alpine</code></li>
</ul>
<ol start="3">
<li>Use <code class="notranslate">grype docker:...</code></li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li><code class="notranslate">grype docker:mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/runtime:6.0-alpine</code></li>
</ul>
<h3 id="desired-behavior" dir="auto">Desired Behavior</h3>
<p>All of the approaches should give me the same results.</p>
<h3 id="actual-behavior" dir="auto">Actual Behavior</h3>
<p>Scanning generated SBOM showed no vulnerability was found.</p>
<div class="snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content=" ❯ trivy sbom runtime-alpine.json
2024-11-01T13:35:46+07:00       INFO    [vuln] Vulnerability scanning is enabled
2024-11-01T13:35:46+07:00       INFO    Detected SBOM format    format=&quot;cyclonedx-json&quot;
2024-11-01T13:35:46+07:00       WARN    Third-party SBOM may lead to inaccurate vulnerability detection
2024-11-01T13:35:46+07:00       WARN    Recommend using Trivy to generate SBOMs
2024-11-01T13:35:46+07:00       INFO    Detected OS     family=&quot;alpine&quot; version=&quot;3.20.3&quot;
2024-11-01T13:35:46+07:00       INFO    [alpine] Detecting vulnerabilities...   os_version=&quot;3.20&quot; repository=&quot;&quot; pkg_num=23
2024-11-01T13:35:46+07:00       INFO    Number of language-specific files       num=1
2024-11-01T13:35:46+07:00       INFO    [nuget] Detecting vulnerabilities...
&#10;runtime-alpine.json (alpine 3.20.3)
&#10;Total: 0 (UNKNOWN: 0, LOW: 0, MEDIUM: 0, HIGH: 0, CRITICAL: 0)">

<div class="comment-body markdown-body wb-break-word p-0 tmp-py-3 overflow-hidden" style="max-height:115px;mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg, #000 80%, transparent);-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg, #000 80%, transparent);">

Hello <a href="https://github.com/Sinderella" class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Sinderella/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self">@Sinderella</a>  
Thanks for your report!

<a href="https://secdb.alpinelinux.org/" rel="nofollow">alpine</a> uses source package name for CVEs - see <a href="https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2024-9143" rel="nofollow">https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2024-9143</a>

In this case source package name for `libcrypto3` is `openssl`.

For `CycloneDX` format - Trivy keeps srcPkg into `properties`:

<div class="highlight highlight-source-json notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" snippet-clipboard-copy-content="      &quot;purl&quot;: &quot;pkg:apk/alpine/libcrypto3@3.3.2-r0?arch=aarch64&amp;distro=3.20.3&quot;,

          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:LayerDiffID&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;sha256:16113d51b7181f20135f51e8ffbaead20a7671cd783017601f198748ce8a8ebf&quot;
        },
        {
          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:PkgID&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;libcrypto3@3.3.2-r0&quot;
        },

<div class="d-none d-sm-inline-flex ml-2">

<tr class="odd d-block">
<td class="d-block color-fg-default comment-body markdown-body js-comment-body"><p>Hello <a href="https://github.com/Sinderella" class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/Sinderella/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self">@Sinderella</a><br />
Thanks for your report!</p>
<p><a href="https://secdb.alpinelinux.org/" rel="nofollow">alpine</a> uses source package name for CVEs - see <a href="https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2024-9143" rel="nofollow">https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2024-9143</a></p>
<p>In this case source package name for <code class="notranslate">libcrypto3</code> is <code class="notranslate">openssl</code>.</p>
<p>For <code class="notranslate">CycloneDX</code> format - Trivy keeps srcPkg into <code class="notranslate">properties</code>:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-json notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="      &quot;purl&quot;: &quot;pkg:apk/alpine/libcrypto3@3.3.2-r0?arch=aarch64&amp;distro=3.20.3&quot;,
      &quot;properties&quot;: [
        {
          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:LayerDiffID&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;sha256:16113d51b7181f20135f51e8ffbaead20a7671cd783017601f198748ce8a8ebf&quot;
        },
        {
          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:PkgID&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;libcrypto3@3.3.2-r0&quot;
        },
        {
          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:PkgType&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;alpine&quot;
        },
        {
          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:SrcName&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;openssl&quot;
        },
        {
          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:SrcVersion&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;3.3.2-r0&quot;
        }">
<pre class="notranslate"><code>      &quot;purl&quot;: &quot;pkg:apk/alpine/libcrypto3@3.3.2-r0?arch=aarch64&amp;distro=3.20.3&quot;,
      &quot;properties&quot;: [
        {
          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:LayerDiffID&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;sha256:16113d51b7181f20135f51e8ffbaead20a7671cd783017601f198748ce8a8ebf&quot;
        },
        {
          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:PkgID&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;libcrypto3@3.3.2-r0&quot;
        },
        {
          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:PkgType&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;alpine&quot;
        },
        {
          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:SrcName&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;openssl&quot;
        },
        {
          &quot;name&quot;: &quot;aquasecurity:trivy:SrcVersion&quot;,
          &quot;value&quot;: &quot;3.3.2-r0&quot;
        }</code></pre>
</div>
<p>Same logic when Trivy decodes <code class="notranslate">CycloneDX</code> file.<br />
Trivy finds srcPkg from <code class="notranslate">properties</code>. If <code class="notranslate">properties</code> doesn't contain <code class="notranslate">srcPkg</code> - Trivy uses pkg name.</p>
<p>UUIC <code class="notranslate">syft</code> saves srcPkg in <code class="notranslate">purl</code> (<code class="notranslate">upstream</code> qualifier).</p>
<p>So Trivy can't find <code class="notranslate">srcPkg</code> for <code class="notranslate">syft</code> report and use <code class="notranslate">libcrypto3</code> for vulnerability detection.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<td class="d-block color-fg-default comment-body markdown-body js-comment-body"><p>Adding a pointer for anyone who lands here later.</p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/DmitriyLewen" class="user-mention notranslate" data-hovercard-type="user" data-hovercard-url="/users/DmitriyLewen/hovercard" data-octo-click="hovercard-link-click" data-octo-dimensions="link_type:self">@DmitriyLewen</a>'s explanation above is the mechanism, and I hit the same<br />
thing on Debian rather than Alpine. I measured the effect size across 22<br />
public images and filed it separately as <a href="https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/discussions/11139" class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="10680226" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/discussions/11139" data-hovercard-type="discussion" data-hovercard-url="/aquasecurity/trivy/discussions/11139/hovercard">#11139</a> rather than reopening<br />
this thread. Nothing there is new about the cause.</p>
<p>Short version: nginx:1.25 gives 137 unique CVEs via trivy sbom on a Syft<br />
CycloneDX SBOM and 409 via trivy image on the same tar. 14 of 22 images<br />
tested show material loss, and the split falls along Debian's source<br />
package advisory model.</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
